name: Row counts per table
sql:
SELECT 'items' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS n FROM items
UNION ALL SELECT 'plays', COUNT(*) FROM plays
UNION ALL SELECT 'enrichment', COUNT(*) FROM enrichment
UNION ALL SELECT 'edges', COUNT(*) FROM edges
UNION ALL SELECT 'collection', COUNT(*) FROM collection
UNION ALL SELECT 'collection_membership', COUNT(*) FROM collection_membership
UNION ALL SELECT 'external_ids', COUNT(*) FROM external_ids
UNION ALL SELECT 'plex_items', COUNT(*) FROM plex_items

name: Titles per type
sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS titles FROM items GROUP BY type ORDER BY titles DESC

name: Top enrichment keys per namespace
sql:
SELECT namespace, key, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS titles,
       COUNT(DISTINCT value) AS distinct_values
FROM enrichment
GROUP BY namespace, key
ORDER BY rows_ DESC
LIMIT 50

name: Plays per account
sql:
SELECT plex_account_id, COUNT(*) AS plays, MIN(viewed_at) AS first_play,
       MAX(viewed_at) AS last_play
FROM plays
GROUP BY plex_account_id
ORDER BY plays DESC

name: enrichment_for: one title, one namespace
sql:
SELECT namespace, key, value, fetched_at
FROM enrichment
WHERE item_id = 'imdb:tt1375666' AND namespace = 'keywords'
ORDER BY key, value

name: enrichment_for_many: several titles, one namespace
sql:
SELECT e.item_id, i.title, i.year, e.namespace, e.key, e.value, e.fetched_at
FROM enrichment e
LEFT JOIN items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
WHERE e.item_id IN ('imdb:tt1375666', 'imdb:tt0133093')
  AND e.namespace = 'keywords'
ORDER BY e.item_id, e.key, e.value

name: edges_from: what a title points at
sql:
SELECT e.from_id, f.title AS from_title, e.to_id, t.title AS to_title,
       t.year AS to_year,
       e.edge_type, e.rank, e.fetched_at
FROM edges e
LEFT JOIN items f ON f.item_id = e.from_id
LEFT JOIN items t ON t.item_id = e.to_id
WHERE e.from_id = 'imdb:tt1375666' AND e.edge_type = 'tmdb_recommendations'
ORDER BY e.rank

name: edges_to: what points at a title
sql:
SELECT e.from_id, f.title AS from_title, f.year AS from_year, e.to_id,
       t.title AS to_title,
       e.edge_type, e.rank, e.fetched_at
FROM edges e
LEFT JOIN items f ON f.item_id = e.from_id
LEFT JOIN items t ON t.item_id = e.to_id
WHERE e.to_id = 'imdb:tt1375666' AND e.edge_type = 'tmdb_recommendations'
ORDER BY e.rank

name: collections_for: a title's collections
sql:
SELECT cm.collection_id, c.source, c.name, c.url, c.size, c.likes,
       cm.rank, cm.mentions, cm.observed_at
FROM collection_membership cm
JOIN collection c ON c.collection_id = cm.collection_id
WHERE cm.item_id = 'imdb:tt1375666'
ORDER BY cm.collection_id

name: taste_vector_for: plays per unit, one account
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id) AS unit, u.title, u.year,
       COUNT(*) AS plays
FROM plays p
JOIN items i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN items u ON u.item_id = COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id)
WHERE p.plex_account_id = 1
GROUP BY unit
ORDER BY unit

name: watched_units_for: one account's watched units
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id) AS unit, u.title, u.year
FROM plays p
JOIN items i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN items u ON u.item_id = COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id)
WHERE p.plex_account_id = 1
ORDER BY unit

name: watched_units: every account's watched units
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id) AS unit, u.title, u.year
FROM plays p
JOIN items i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN items u ON u.item_id = COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id)
ORDER BY unit

name: pooled_taste_vector: plays per unit, all accounts
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id) AS unit, u.title, u.year,
       COUNT(*) AS plays
FROM plays p
JOIN items i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN items u ON u.item_id = COALESCE(i.show_item_id, p.item_id)
GROUP BY unit
ORDER BY plays DESC

name: Season lengths (median-season input)
sql:
SELECT e.show_item_id, s.title, s.year, e.season, COUNT(*) AS episodes
FROM items e
LEFT JOIN items s ON s.item_id = e.show_item_id
WHERE e.type = 'episode' AND e.show_item_id IS NOT NULL AND e.season IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.show_item_id, e.season
ORDER BY e.show_item_id, episodes

name: Attributes of one title (attributes_by_item, narrowed)
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.item_id, i.title, i.year, e.namespace, e.key, e.value
FROM enrichment e
LEFT JOIN items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
WHERE e.item_id = 'imdb:tt1375666'
ORDER BY e.item_id, e.namespace, e.key, e.value
